primitive: robust GLM and Bayes linear coefficient covariance
r_function: sandwich::vcovHC(glm, type = HC0..HC3), vcovCL(glm, cluster, type = 'HC1'), NeweyWest(glm, lag, order.by, prewhite = FALSE, adjust = TRUE); lmtest::coeftest(glm, vcov); Bayes: the Muller (2013) sandwich posterior in closed form
note: family binomial (y_bin ~ x1 + x2, logit), poisson (y_count, log) or bayes (y, REG_BAYES_LINEAR under the default prior: mu0 = 0, precision 1e-3). Rows shuffled; week orders the series, region the six clusters. Weights follow the one rule (w* = w * N*/sum(w)); GLM w* are prior weights; Bayes is frequency-only. GLM: the sandwich over IRLS scores at the converged weights, Wald z (p_values = 2 pnorm(-|b/se|)). Bayes: coefficients the posterior mean, vcov the sandwich with bread Lambda_n^-1, no p-values. ci at 0.95 on qnorm(0.975). lags: the request, lags_used the resolved floor(4 (n/100)^(2/9)).
